outcome: bladder spasm pain (measured by visual pain analogue score)
cohort: 31 patients who underwent surgery for genitourinary fistula, with causes being obstetric in 21 cases and iatrogenic in 9 cases.
finding: Anticholinergic medication (Solifenacin) combined with prolonged catheterization was effective in increasing suture line healing, decreasing bladder spasm, relaxing the detrusor muscle, and ultimately improving the success rate and reducing the failure rate of genitourinary fistula surgery.
